Now hosted by Stephen Mulhern, the series will see contestants battle it out against the notorious Banker to be in with a chance of winning a life-changing cash prize in a nail-biting game of nerves and intuition. utv.uk.title: Winter - Back to the Start
utv.uk.description: When a car crashes in woodland, the team discover the body of a young woman dressed in a strange old-fashioned gown. Winter quickly establishes that she died hours before the collision, turning what appears to be a tragic accident into something far more disturbing. Bell and Daldry trace the vehicle to a group of men on a stag do, but their accounts don't add up and it is clear they are concealing the truth. As Winter's examination reveals evidence that the victim endured years of captivity and abuse, the investigation becomes a desperate race to uncover her identity and the life she was forced to live. Pursuing every lead pushes Winter to take steps that put him directly in harm's way leaving the team in a frantic bid to save not only him but also another innocent life. Meanwhile, a major breakthrough in the Triangle case leads Winter and Bell to an unexpected location where they uncover evidence that could change everything they thought they knew. utv.uk.title: Tonight - Thursday 5 Nov
utv.uk.description: The violent murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak shocked Britain after footage of his final moments came to light at the trial of his attacker in June. Captured on the police's body-worn camera, false accusations by the aggressor against Henry, alongside his pleas to police as he lay dying, caused national uproar. In an exclusive and deeply revealing interview with ITV's Paul Brand, Henry's family share memories of a much-loved son and brother whose life was cut tragically short, while asking searching questions about the treatment he received, and the police investigation that followed. It is also the story of a family's determination to uncover the truth, secure change and ensure that Henry is remembered not for his tragic murder but for the life he lived.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny put on a puppet show, sing and play who's the odd one out.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: A frog! Play the sound game with Bow Wow to hear a frog's sound! What item is missing in the 3-of-a-kind game? An apple!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Can you guess where Hippa was? In the bath! Play the sound game with Bow Wow to hear a cat's sound! What item is in the 3-of-a-kind game? An umbrella!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Little Lola and Charlie have fun with the animals on the farm. Join them in this classic rendition of Old McDonald.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Giraffe get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of giraffes cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Mr. Bear has brought Ms. Bear.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Bear get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola as she has fun on the farm. Play with scarecrow and three jolly birds! See how ram helps lamb reach the apples!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola as she has fun on the farm. Play with rabbit and foal and see who is near and far! See how bull helps calf reach the oranges!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Just before reaching the treasure, the Lollipops need to solve a puzzle. Come join them and help

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail sets out on an adventure to the puddle! Join him as he meets a bird and discovers the taste of puddle water!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Little Cabin in the Woods is a popular and fun song that teaches toddlers and young children colors and shapes with yummy fruits.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry take care of a tortoise egg until it hatches. The bring it clothes, toys, dolls and even a trampoline! Will it hatch?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: It's nighttime and the cricket band is playing music! Pix is having trouble sleeping. Will Pix be able to find who is making all that noise?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli and Leela find the perfect muddy mud slide but they can't persuade Gray to join in the fun. Will he be able to overcome his fear?

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A key arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused key discover its true use? S3 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A net arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused net discover its true use? S3 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Come ride through the town with your favorite BabyTV characters - Baby Butterfly, Elephant, Giraffe, Sheep, Rabit and Squirrel.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Come pick potatoes with your favorite BabyTV friends - Hippo, elephant, Squirrel, Rabbit and Baby!

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Little Petite has a hole in her tire and she can't ride her bike. Can Mikey help her find a creative solution? S1 Ep7

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Today Hal is a brave astronaut and he'd like a costume for his tricycle too. Can Mike find a costume that can fit Hal's tricycle too? S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Petite and little sister Bonbon are on their way to ballet class. But Bonbon is getting too heavy to carry and Petite can't give her a ride anymore. S1 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a thermometer and band aids! Help fix butterfly's torn wing and see him fly again! S1 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles stars and a spaceship! Help use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A shower head? Of course not! It's toilet paper!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun using pan lids as cymbals, singing, and dancing in their band.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam have fun picking oranges from the tree and catching them in a bowl.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel is sleeping soundly when the ferry Ki takes him on a magical journey in the sky. Join them as they float through the stars and the moon.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe, Squirrel, and Baby want to play with a ball. Will they be able to take the ball from Elephant's house without waking her up? S1 Ep15

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Rabbit is great at doing magic tricks. Will Baby butterfly be able to be a true magician? Join them as they have fun pulling surprises out of hats. S1 Ep19

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Hippo have planned a day at the beach together. But once they get there, Hippo disappears. Come join Baby as he looks for Hippo. S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.description: Ellie looks for the ball in the water and sees another elephant copying his movements! Ducky and Froggy see a duck and frog in the water too!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Come have fun with bubbles in the tub! Froggy has a bubble head, Ellie gets a bubble beard and Ducky looks like a sheep!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie and Froggy are planning a surprise birthday party for Ducky! Help hang balloons and decorate the cake!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends stumble upon a green frog and follow it all the way to a field, where they meet a nice worm and a shy snail.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends make bubbles in the water as they go on an underwater adventure inside a bubble.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play with building blocks as they suddenly go to a construction site. S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Tickles gives his friends lemonade from a machine he built, but it's not tasty.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Tickles invites his friends for a housewarming party in his tree house, but it is too small so Yum Yum leaves.

babytv.uk.description: Oink Oink! What item is missing in the mixed up airplane picture game? What item is in the 3-of-a-kind game? A clown bowtie!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Play the sound game with Bow Wow to hear a clock's sound! Guess what's hiding behind the hidden picture game? A teddy bear!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of cats cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Max has brought Bear.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Penguin get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of dogs cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Paul has brought Penguin.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she sees which animal has a red crest! Come along and learn which animal has wings and orange feet!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has horns! Come along and learn which animal has funny ears and grey spots!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Finding the treasure is important, but so is cleaning the ocean! The girls clean up ocean with the help of a friendly octopus

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: It's Autumn! It's getting chilly and the leaves start to fall! Join Mr. Snail as he meets Robin Red Breast.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail has fun exploring ants! Discover that some ants care for the kids, others guard the food, and some build the nest.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Perry wants to play with Harley but Harley keeps falling asleep. Will Perry manage to wake her up?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Hey! A coconut just fell from the tree. It's fun to play with a coconut. Catch, Leo! Catch, Pix! But who will get it first? S1 Ep12

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Ikki finds herself in a bind when she gets her quills stuck in tree. When Mowgli comes along and offers to help, she thinks he wants to eat her!

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A tent arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused tent discover its true use?

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A vase arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused vase discover its true use? S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Johnny is very thirsty. The fountain doesn't work and Johnny needs help to find a solution for water.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Bunny's helmet is a little too big for her head. She needs a better solution and a smaller helmet. Can Mikey help? S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Petite can't reach the seat of her bicycle. It is too high. What can Mikey do to help her? Let's see...

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles an engine and train cars! Help create parachutes when the train runs out of tracks!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magician's hat and wand! Help conduct a magic show with flying doves and feathers!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Mice Builders are enthusiastically devoted to building their new house. When a messenger arrives with a package, they put down their tools and attempt to guess what's inside. S1 Ep18

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: When the kites get stuck, they are left with the strings and find imaginative ways to play with them and wag their new "tails"!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they use the broom and mop sticks to giddy up on their horses, imagining themselves as two knights in shining armor!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Draco has fun ice skating with Billy and Bambam, a snowman and a Christmas tree.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Giraffe want to build a snowman together, but by the time Giraffe is ready to go out - all the snow has melted? S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel has invited Baby to sleep over. What happens when Squirrel wants to go to sleep but Baby still wants to have fun? S1 Ep26

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby has picked beautiful flowers for sheep but is having trouble flying while holding the flowers. Luckily, he has her good friends. S1 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Froggy fishes a chest! What's inside? Fancy dress clothes! See Ducky dress as a Native American, Ellie as a clown and Froggy as a lion!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are asleep on a boat when a sudden wave soaks them! See the splashing dolphin in the water!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: It's snowing in the bath! Join Ducky, Ellie and Froggy as they ski over the snow and meet a big snowman and a friendly penguin!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends water a small plant as it becomes huge, and by sitting on the leaves, you can see the view of the city.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play in a pond with an umbrella as the umbrella becomes a boat and they go into sea, where they meat dolphins and end up on a beach.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends complete a firetruck puzzle as the firetruck becomes real and they drive it and save a cat stuck on a tree.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Uh Oh, Dodo and Yum Yum startle a frog even though they didn't mean to. Join Tickles as he takes the frog to the safest place for frogs.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: The friends are on their way to the boat parade to sail their boats, but all the boats sink. Join Dodo as he builds a paper sailboat.

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Won't Back Down
cinemax.us.description: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching. (Drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemax.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector. (Comedy) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemax.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Animated, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Lobster
cinemax.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth. - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting. - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemax.us.description: A part-time state park employee faces her worst fears as she guards the site of a potential crime scene deep in the wilderness. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: A Marine (Matthew Modine) and his companions (Adam Baldwin, Vincent D'Onofrio) endure basic training under a sadistic drill sergeant and fight in the 1968 Tet offensive. - 1987

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform at the Talk of the Town nightclub in 1968. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate). - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Man Down
cinemax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2016-11-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1955-04-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Son of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tike from the gargantuan bugs? (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1967-12-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxaction.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1989

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 1999-05-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemaxaction.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Mystery) - 2012-11-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxaction.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Drama, Movie, Musical) - 2006-04-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Room
cinemaxaction.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxaction.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1999-01-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 2000-10-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxaction.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2016-09-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemaxaction.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Movie) - 2024-08-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: It
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Mystery) - 1990

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1981-01-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1972-03-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1971-07-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-03-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxaction.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxaction.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction) - 2011-10-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. (Adventure, Biography, Crime, Drama, Historical drama) - 2017-09-07

comedydynamics.us.title: Tiffany Haddish: She Ready! From the Hood to Hollywood!
comedydynamics.us.description: Rising comedy star Tiffany Haddish takes the stage in her hometown of Los Angeles to tackle subjects ranging from her early days in foster care and being bullied on the playground to getting her revenge on ex-boyfriends.

comedydynamics.us.title: Nemr: No Bombing in Beirut
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed in Lebanon and America, the comic discusses his childhood in America and his later years in Lebanon.

comedydynamics.us.title: More Funny Women of a Certain Age
comedydynamics.us.description: Caroline Rhea headlines a cast of women for a night of uninhibited stand-up comedy; featuring Carol Leifer, Tammy Pescatelli, Thea Vidale, Carole Montgomery, and Julia Scotti.

comedydynamics.us.title: Louie Anderson: Big Baby Boomer
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic discusses topics such as bad habits, pesky family members, and his aging body.

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
comedydynamics.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
comedydynamics.us.description: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
comedydynamics.us.description: From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming world view shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps and first loves.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
comedydynamics.us.description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

comedydynamics.us.title: Robert Schimmel: Life Since Then
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian and author Robert Schimmel has plenty to say on everything from raising a 17-year-old daughter to bargaining with God, and not making friends with a dolphin.

comedydynamics.us.title: Marc Yaffee: Mid-Laugh Crisis
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Marc Yaffee performs in a stand-up special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

comedydynamics.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
comedydynamics.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated
comedydynamics.us.description: A comedy performance by Arnez J at Boston's Wilbur Theater.

comedydynamics.us.title: Dennis Miller: America 180
comedydynamics.us.description: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tom Papa: Human Mule
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford: Home for the Holidays
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic performs in St. Louis, discussing Christmas as a child, feeling guilty on Mother's Day, Thanksgiving and Disneyland.

comedydynamics.us.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
comedydynamics.us.description: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

comedydynamics.us.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
comedydynamics.us.description: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

comedydynamics.us.title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
comedydynamics.us.description: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
comedydynamics.us.description: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

comedydynamics.us.title: Brendan Fitzgibbons: I Am the Resistance
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Brendan Fitzgibbons makes his stand-up album debut; he digs into the wild world of single life, why dating apps now feel like rescue shelters and more.

comedydynamics.us.title: Cory Kahaney: Antique Joke Show
comedydynamics.us.description: Cory Kahaney makes all the painstaking aspects of daily life ironic and uproariously funny.

comedydynamics.us.title: Dom Irrera: Live From Las Vegas
comedydynamics.us.description: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy.

comedydynamics.us.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
comedydynamics.us.description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
comedydynamics.us.description: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Garcia
comedydynamics.us.description: The Ten Dollar Ticket Jeff Garcia aims to give audiences their money's worth with his signature original shows in this 2008 special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Joe Devito: First of All...
comedydynamics.us.description: Navigating the world of dating over 40 is akin to embarking on a thrift store shopping spree, and Joe DeVito is no stranger to the game; with wit and wisdom, DeVito captures the hilarious truths of dating in this age bracket.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
comedydynamics.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
comedydynamics.us.description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
comedydynamics.us.description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

comedydynamics.us.title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
comedydynamics.us.description: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Pepitone: In Ruins
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Eddie Pepitone performs dark humor in his hometown of Brooklyn.

comedydynamics.us.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
comedydynamics.us.description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

comedydynamics.us.title: Michael Yo: Blasian
comedydynamics.us.description: Michael Yo brings his personal blend of comedy to his debut stand up special; born and raised in Houston, Michael talks about growing up mixed in a place where he really stood out.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
comedydynamics.us.description: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

comedydynamics.us.title: Tim Allen: Men Are Pigs
comedydynamics.us.description: The comedian examines man's obsession with hardware at the State Theater in Kalamazoo, Mich.

comedydynamics.us.title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
comedydynamics.us.description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Squire: Bam Bam
comedydynamics.us.description: Performing in his hometown of Cleveland, comedian Bill Squire looks at his role as a parent as well as the experiences with his parents that lead to this moment.

gritxtra.us.title: Ulzana's Raid
gritxtra.us.description: When word arrives that Apache warrior Ulzana has assembled a war party and left the reservation, the United States Army pegs veteran tracker McIntosh (Burt Lancaster) and Apache Ke-Ni-Tay (Jorge Luke) to lead a young, prejudiced lieutenant's (Bruce Davison) troops to find Ulzana. Outmaneuvered and unfamiliar with the terrain, the cavalry struggles to stop the long-mistreated and raging Apaches from destroying everything in their path in what initially seem like senseless acts of violence. (Movie, Western) - 1972-10-18

gritxtra.us.title: The Professionals
gritxtra.us.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Western) - 1966-11-02

gritxtra.us.title: Devil's Doorway
gritxtra.us.description: Lance Poole (Robert Taylor) is a Native American who left his tribal homelands to fight for the Union in the Civil War. Despite earning the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic duties in the line of fire, when he returns home he's still faced with hatred and racism from the white community that neighbors his village. Unable to own property because he's not considered a citizen of the United States, he fights a lawyer's (Louis Calhern) attempts to take over his tribe's hard-earned land. (Movie, Western) - 1950

gritxtra.us.title: Ulzana's Raid
gritxtra.us.description: When word arrives that Apache warrior Ulzana has assembled a war party and left the reservation, the United States Army pegs veteran tracker McIntosh (Burt Lancaster) and Apache Ke-Ni-Tay (Jorge Luke) to lead a young, prejudiced lieutenant's (Bruce Davison) troops to find Ulzana. gritxtra.us.title: The Tall Stranger
gritxtra.us.description: Union vet Ned (Joel McCrea), gunned down by some tough cattle rustlers, comes to in a wagon train under the care of kindly widow Ellen (Virginia Mayo). But, as he heals, he senses all is not well, and realizes that the suspicious men leading the train are taking the settlers to land owned by his estranged half-brother, an embittered man who will shoot any strangers. Ned then tries to warn the pioneers, while preparing to face the sibling who harbors a deep-seated grudge against him. (Movie, Western) - 1957-11-17

gritxtra.us.title: Westbound
gritxtra.us.description: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier. (Movie, Western) - 1959

gritxtra.us.title: The Man Behind the Gun
gritxtra.us.description: An Army major goes undercover to stop a dangerous plot to make Southern California a separate state, facing immense personal risk and complex challenges. (Movie, Western) - 1953-01-31

gritxtra.us.title: Thunder Over the Plains
gritxtra.us.description: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteren Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses. (Movie, Western) - 1953

gritxtra.us.title: Apache Rifles
gritxtra.us.description: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona. (Action, Movie, Western) - 1965

gritxtra.us.title: Major Dundee
gritxtra.us.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow. (Movie, War, Western) - 1965-03-15

history.us.description: Dr. David Jeremiah shares the practical messages behind Christianity and helps people to discover their own turning points in their relationship with God.

history.us.title: Tuskegee Airmen: Legacy of Courage
history.us.description: Exploring the legacy of the Tuskegee Airmen, the legendary group of African American pilots, revealing how these warriors for change helped end segregation in the military and pave the way for the civil rights movement.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - The Beginning
history.us.description: In September 1939, Germany invades Poland, setting the stage for the most destructive war in history.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Blitz
history.us.description: After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Barbarossa
history.us.description: Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Pearl Harbor
history.us.description: Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - The War at Sea
history.us.description: Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Guadalcanal
history.us.description: After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Darkness Falls
history.us.description: As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Operation Torch
history.us.description: The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Secrets and Lies
history.us.description: Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Stalingrad
history.us.description: In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Italy
history.us.description: The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results.

history.us.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Battle for the Skies
history.us.description: Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe. (Documentary, History, War) - 2026-06-29

mgmplus.us.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
mgmplus.us.description: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner. (Drama) - 1961

mgmplus.us.title: Max 2: White House Hero
mgmplus.us.description: Max, a military service dog, is assigned to serve on the U.S. president's Secret Service detail. (Children, Drama) - 2017

mgmplus.us.title: Alive
mgmplus.us.description: Following the conflicts in Iraq and Afghanistan, injured veterans turn to adaptive athletics to heal their physical and emotional battle wounds. (Documentary) - 2019

mgmplus.us.title: Boomerang
mgmplus.us.description: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

mgmplus.us.title: Nobody's Fool
mgmplus.us.description: Donald "Sully" Sullivan (Paul Newman) is an expert at avoiding adult responsibilities. At 60, he divides all his time between a local bar and the occasional construction job. When his estranged son, Peter (Dylan Walsh), arrives in town, bringing with him a son of his own and a sob story about his failed marriage, Sully finds himself assuming the roles of both father and grandfather. After a life of unchecked self-indulgence, he wonders if he is up to the task. (Drama) - 1994

mgmplus.us.title: Cadillac Man
mgmplus.us.description: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage. (Comedy) - 1990

mgmplus.us.title: Chaplin
mgmplus.us.description: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charles Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography) - 1992

mgmplus.us.title: Mystic Pizza
mgmplus.us.description: For sexy Daisy Araujo, her sensible sister Kat and their wisecracking friend Jojo, the summer after high school is a summer they can never forget. Slinging pizza at a local restaurant, the three girls share their hopes, dreams and plans for escaping their small town. (Romantic comedy) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Home for the Holidays
mgmplus.us.description: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). But the evening gets interesting when sparks fly between Claudia and her brother's handsome friend Leo Fish (Dylan McDermott). (Holiday, Comedy) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: The American President
mgmplus.us.description: With the end of his first term in sight, widowed U.S. President Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas) knows that overwhelming public support will guarantee his re-election. But when he falls in love with lobbyist Sydney Ellen Wade (Annette Bening), Shepherd's supporters question the relationship, and his approval ratings drop. As a rival presidential candidate goes on the attack, Shepherd must choose between his political career and his love for Sydney. (Romance, Comedy drama) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: Legally Blonde

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Super Low Metro
motortrend.us.description: A weather-beaten 1959 Metro rolls into the shop for a makeover from the inside out; the vehicle's new owner gets a surprise twist. (Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 2017-07-25

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Good to Go GTO
motortrend.us.description: Known for its sizzling performance and smooth body style, the 1969 Pontiac GTO is one of the fastest cars of its time; Joe gives it his signature twist with body modifications and a new power train. (Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 2017-08-15

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - King Cobra
motortrend.us.description: After two decades of birthdays, graduations and college, the owner of a '65 AC Cobra replica shifts his attention from the kids and grandkids to his other baby; he will need the Squad's help putting some bite back into this car. (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2019-09-04

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Rising to the Challenge
motortrend.us.description: The team repays a disabled Vietnam combat veteran for his service to his country by rebuilding his 1970 Dodge Challenger. (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2019-09-18

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - The Mercury Is Falling!
motortrend.us.description: The crew tries to rescue a 1949 Mercury that has been decaying in a garage for years due to its owner's myriad personal and family health problems. (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2019-10-02

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Junkyard Genius
motortrend.us.description: Andy is in hog heaven when he finds a classic Chevrolet Blazer on the roadside and wins a totaled Porsche Cayman on a bid. (Reality, Auto) - 2017-05-03

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Cohen vs. Camaro
motortrend.us.description: Andy jumps at the opportunity to purchase a 1967 Chevrolet Camaro pace car, but the rare, valuable classic is currently in pieces. (Reality, Auto) - 2017-06-07

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Indy to Win It
motortrend.us.description: Andy throws the entire garage into chaos when he discovers a 1967 Chevrolet Camaro pace car and decides to unveil his masterpiece at an upcoming car show. (Reality, Auto) - 2017-06-14

motortrend.us.title: Truck Dynasty - It's a Boat. It's a Truck. It's BoatTruck.
motortrend.us.description: Due to a windfall from a custom project, Joe plans to create the Boat Truck, an amphibious Jeep; with a buyer for the Defender falling through, Pop, Jerry Jr. and Frank are tasked with finding buyers for both the Defender and the Boat Truck. (Reality, Auto) - 2025-08-26

motortrend.us.title: Truck Dynasty - Hummer, but Make It Bigger
motortrend.us.description: A repeat client wants a tall, big work truck, so the team decides to build the world's first-ever, lifted Hummer EV; Ashley sets a company sales goal of 25 trucks at the upcoming Palm Beach Boat Show, sparking family tension. (Reality, Auto) - 2025-09-02

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Denali Drop
motortrend.us.description: A client wants Bill to set the bar for custom SUVs with a 2018 Yukon Denali; the guys get busy with chassis, body mods, interior and twin turbos; Ekstensive goes full gangster with a 1948 Mercury, remaking a legendary car from the inside out. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-11-07

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Buckin' Bronco
motortrend.us.description: Ekstensive's built a lot of trucks, but never a Ford Bronco until now; Bill and the guys transform a rusted '68 Bronco roadster into a high-powered off-roading truck with a supercharged engine, handmade dash, roll cage, and waterproof interior. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-12-12

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Beyond ZL1
motortrend.us.description: The 2018 Camaro ZL1 is already a high performance sports car, but the owner wants Bill to improve his even more; the guys are happy to oblige, starting with a handmade aluminum chassis and interior; a new client wants his Sierra Denali frame dropped. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-11-14

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Beyond ZL1, Part 2
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the gang are back under the hood of the 2018 Camaro ZL1, rebuilding the engine to add as much power as possible before a visit to the dynamometer; Ekstensive tries to turn a patinated 1949 GMC pickup sleeper truck into a keeper truck. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-11-21

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - The Grand Finale
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-01-09

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Street Rod Milk Truck
motortrend.us.description: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-12-19

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - C10 to a Hundred
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track. (Reality, Auto) - 2018-12-05

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - The Tale of the Cockatoo and the Kitty Cat ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A cockatoo enjoys giving massages to her once-feral feline friend, a California man takes a goat surfing, and a dog befriends an eagle owl.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Titan's Hero ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Critter Fixers call an unexpected hero to save a sick puppy named Titan.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Hiss The Night ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Snake City is hammered by summer storms as Simon and Siouxsie hunt for a black mamba in a pile of tiles by torchlight. When the skies clear, Sioux gets tangled up in a deadly game of tug-of-war with a feisty forest cobra.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Animals Gone Wild - The Bold And The Brutal ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A pair of giraffes battle viciously for dominance, a fisherman is caught by feeding alligators, and a buffalo tosses a lion like a rag doll.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Urban Jungle ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Soon two-thirds of the global population will be living in cities, leaving wild animals to develop a whole new set of street smarts, such as a hungry bear raiding a supermarket, or a raccoon figuring out how to open a wildlife-proof bin.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Pro Bone-O Work ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Schroeders examine the state trooper K9s and join a training session; Dr. Ben saves a cat that ate string; Dr. Erin helps a dog after an attack.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Real Black Panther ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: There's a new challenger in the Kabini Forest of India, one unlike all leopards that came before him. This is the story of Saya, the real black panther, and his rise to power.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Europe From Above - Norway ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: This unique aerial voyage across Norway reveals the world's longest deep-sea cable, a 13th century church restoration and a breathtaking postal route.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: When Sharks Attack - Gulf Fear ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Gulf Shores, Alabama is an idyllic beach town and fishing haven on the Gulf of Mexico. Since 2000, this pocket of paradise has been ravaged by a series of terrifying shark attacks.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Drugs And Divorce ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A divorced couple denies travelling together, but carry identical bags filled with cocaine. When a bag containing a white powder tests negative for cocaine, police decide to dig deeper.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - You Ain't Nothin' But a Hound Dog ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr Oakley treats a Sitka deer with a recurring limp, an alpaca-llama cross with an attitude, and guards the family dog from a wandering hound.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Canine Get a Witness ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: As ZooTampa prepares for a birth, an orangutan mama breaks all the rules.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wild India - The Badlands ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In India's deserts, predators and prey battle each other and the harshest of landscapes for food, water and breeding rights.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wild India - The Monsoon Forest ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: India's monsoon forest is a place of sanctuary and extremes. All live by the law of the seasons.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Something Bit Me! - No Time to Be Terrified ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the San Gabriel Mountains above Los Angeles, one false step turns a young couple's romantic hike into a desperate battle to save life and limb.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Winter's Payback ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: When a huge supermarket truck crashes on the E6, Jo Roger asks his old friend and former employee Roger to make a comeback. In the southern mountains, Thord and Andrzej discover what it is like to have to be rescued.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Yellowstone Winter ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Casey treks deep into Yellowstone's wild backcountry, braving severe cold, freak snowstorms, and dangerous animal encounters. (Documentary, Animals) - 2010-09-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Cobra Chaos ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Simon and Sioux face a keelback snake stuck in a water tank. (Reality, Animals, Documentary) - 2023-07-05

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Nerves of Steer ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Horses are driving Dr Pol wild as he works to fix chunky runny noses, gruesome gashes and even penile problems. He's always up to the challenge, but it's a horse of a different colour when Dr Pol is asked to deliver a commencement address to the entire graduating class of Central Michigan University. He's known for being good with his hands, but keeping his foot out of his mouth will be the real trick! (Reality, Animals) - 2015-01-10

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Don't Have a Cow ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley treats a kitten with a bulging eye, and Sierra preg checks a miniature cow. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2023-06-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Against the Wind ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Alaska Natives work to rebuild after an unprecedented storm surge flooded and devastated coastal villages. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure) - 2023-06-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment. (Shopping, Consumer) - 2002-03-06

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - Hero Cat ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A boy is saved by his heroic family cat, a dog who mothers a goat, and a man who spoils his pet deer. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2015-03-27

screenpix.us.title: The Belly of an Architect
screenpix.us.description: Stourley Kracklite (Brian Dennehy), a driven, detail-obsessed architect, travels from America to Rome with his much younger wife, Louisa (Chloe Webb), to oversee an architectural homage to a personal hero, 18th-century master builder Etienne-Louis Boullée. En route by train, Stourley and Louisa conceive a much-wanted child -- but Stourley's obsession with his wife's expanding belly, her perceived infidelity, and his own recurrent bouts of abdominal pain reach epic and dangerous proportions. (Comedy drama) - 1987

screenpix.us.title: Lord Love a Duck
screenpix.us.description: An unusually gifted high school senior, Alan Musgrave (Roddy McDowall), decides to direct his mental powers toward helping an innocent new student, Barbara Ann Greene (Tuesday Weld), achieve her goal of popularity. With Alan's guidance, Barbara climbs the social ladder, finds a husband and eventually gets a shot at a glamorous movie career. But when Barbara's husband begins to get in the way of her ambitions, Alan will stop at nothing to make sure she reaches the top. (Comedy) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices. (War, Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Marshal Law

screenpix.us.title: The Wild Angels

Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good. (Action) - 1966

screenpix.us.description: A figure skater's (Sonja Henie) boozing husband (Michael O'Shea) joins an ice show after being barred from hockey for life. (Drama) - 1945

screenpix.us.title: Eight on the Lam
screenpix.us.description: A widower with seven children, Henry Dimsdale (Bob Hope) is employed as a bank teller. After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their babysitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton). (Comedy) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpix.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades. (Comedy drama) - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Bikini Machine
screenpixaction.us.description: The dastardly Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) and his sidekick, Igor (Jack Mullaney), build a race of bikini-wearing beauties who are designed to win the hearts and fortunes of the most influential men of the world. Before long, the manufactured women begin to succeed, and Robot 11 (Susan Hart) is sent to coax multimillionaire Todd Armstrong (Dwayne Hickman) into handing over his wealth. Government spy Craig Gamble (Frankie Avalon) tracks down Robot 11, but even he isn't immune to her charms. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Girl Bombs
screenpixaction.us.description: The scheming Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) is determined to conquer the world yet again, this time by deploying a legion of explosive robots that happen to look like gorgeous women. Fortunately for the citizens of the globe, suave secret agent Bill Dexter (Fabian) is out to foil Goldfoot's plans, which involve kidnapping a prominent American general (also Price) who bears a striking resemblance to Goldfoot. Also getting in on the antics is inept aspiring spy Franco (Franco Franchi). (Science fiction) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade
screenpixaction.us.description: During the Crimean War between Britain and Russia in the 1850s, a British cavalry division, led by the overbearing Lord Cardigan (Trevor Howard), engages in an infamously reckless strategic debacle against a Russian artillery battery. An inept chain of command and the arrogance of the aristocratic officers nearly destroys the brigade. Interpersonal wars within the unit, including unfaithful wives and a rivalry between Lord Cardigan and Captain Nolan (David Hemmings), heighten the conflict. (Historical drama) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Hannibal Brooks
screenpixaction.us.description: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis. (Comedy drama, War) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Russians Are Coming, the Russians Are Coming
screenpixaction.us.description: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander (Theodore Bikel) orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov (Alan Arkin), to get them moving again before there is an international incident. Rozanov seeks assistance from the island locals, including the police chief (Brian Keith) and a vacationing television writer (Carl Reiner), while trying to allay their fears of a Communist invasion by claiming he and his crew are Norwegian sailors. (Comedy) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: War, Italian Style
screenpixaction.us.description: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy. (Comedy) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: The Square Peg
screenpixaction.us.description: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops. (Comedy) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Matchless
screenpixaction.us.description: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible. (Comedy) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.description: A young woman's inherent honesty leads to the downfall of her conniving boyfriend's scams. (Drama) - 1952

screenpixaction.us.title: The Girl in Black Stockings
screenpixaction.us.description: Residents at a posh Utah hotel become suspects when a girl is found murdered during a pool party. Local sheriff Jess Holmes (John Dehner) takes charge of the investigation and must discover who among the terrified guests and staff -- including bodacious vixen Harriet Ames (Mamie Van Doren), the hotel's bitter, crippled proprietor (Ron Randell), visiting lawyer David Hewson (Lex Barker) and his secretary, Beth (Anne Bancroft) -- is the culprit, even as murders continue to take place. (Mystery) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: The Wild Party
screenpixaction.us.description: An ex-football brute (Anthony Quinn) and his beatnik gang take a rich girl (Carol Ohmart) and her boyfriend hostage (Arthur Franz) at a jazz joint. - 1956

screenpixaction.us.description: A New York boxer (Jamie Smith) corners a dancer's (Irene Kane) bad boss (Frank Silvera) in a mannequin factory. - 1955

screenpixaction.us.description: A college student (Robert Wagner) kills his rich girlfriend (Joanne Woodward), then charms her sister (Virginia Leith) who does not know who he is. - 1956

screenpixaction.us.description: An editor (John Forsythe) flees to Washington with his wife (Joan Camden) to testify at the Kefauver organized-crime hearings. - 1952

screenpixaction.us.title: Cloudburst
screenpixaction.us.description: A former British commando (Robert Preston) tracks down the occupants of a hit-and-run car that killed his wife (Elizabeth Sellars). - 1951

screenpixaction.us.description: A World War I veteran (John Payne) marries a stranger (Gloria McGhee) and becomes a crooked Midwestern political boss. - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Devil's 8
screenpixaction.us.description: A federal agent (Christopher George) trains escaped chain-gang convicts for a mission to bust a Southern moonshine racket. - 1969

screenpixaction.us.description: Sean's brother plays a hypnotic plastic surgeon (Neil Connery), pressed into service as a James Bond-type spy. - 1967
