screenpixaction.us.title: Billion Dollar Brain
screenpixaction.us.description: Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is a former British secret agent who has taken up work as a private detective. An anonymous party hires him to deliver a seemingly normal package to Helsinki. However, he learns that he has been deceived into working for the Secret Service again, and is actually returning stolen virus-infected eggs to a government lab. Palmer is then persuaded to thwart a manic Texas oil baron (Ed Begley) who is planning to attack the Soviet Union with a supercomputer. (Drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Assassination
screenpixaction.us.description: A Secret Service agent (Charles Bronson) and the president's wife (Jill Ireland) flee from a senator's (Michael Ansara) hit man. (Action) - 1987

screenpixaction.us.title: Triple Deception
screenpixaction.us.description: Police in Paris recruit an English ship's officer (Michael Craig) to help trap counterfeiters by joining them. (Crime drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: The Killer Elite
screenpixaction.us.description: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

screenpixaction.us.title: Foreign Intrigue
screenpixaction.us.description: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place. (Drama) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Pier 5, Havana
screenpixaction.us.description: Miami businessman Steve Daggett (Cameron Mitchell) arrives in Havana in the wake of the revolution, looking for his army buddy Hank (Logan Field), a hard-drinking mechanic who has suddenly vanished. Steve follows a trail that leads him to the apartment of his old flame -- Hank's current wife, Monica (Allison Hayes) -- and to a boat shop where he is beaten up by strangers and warned to leave Cuba. He discovers that Hank's disappearance is linked to a conspiracy to depose Fidel Castro. (Adventure) - 1959

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bamboo Gods and Iron Men
screenpixvoices.us.description: Filipino gangsters hound a trio (James Iglehart, Shirley Washington, Chiquito) whose carved Buddha hides something to control the world. (Action, Martial arts) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Catch the Heat
screenpixvoices.us.description: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants. (Action) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Original Gangstas
screenpixvoices.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.). (Drama) - 1969

screenpixvoices.us.title: Anna Lucasta
screenpixvoices.us.description: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult. (Drama) - 1958

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diggstown
screenpixvoices.us.description: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on. (Action) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpixvoices.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpixvoices.us.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
screenpixvoices.us.description: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down. (Comedy) - 1973

screenpixvoices.us.title: Amazing Grace
screenpixvoices.us.description: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor. (Comedy) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Ride Back
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Determined to redeem his life as a failure, Sheriff Chris Hamish crosses the Mexican border to find an outlaw named Kallen and extradite him to Texas for a fair trial. Hamish arrests Kallen, who doubts the sheriff's ability to bring him to justice and makes several attempts to escape. But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Yellow Tomahawk
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After commanding the brutal slaughter of a Cheyenne tribe, callous cavalry leader Maj. Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Reed passes on the message, which falls on deaf ears, and chaos ensues. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - A Noose Fits Anybody
screenpixwesterns.us.description: While rushing to the aid of his brother, Ben Thompson saves Bat's life but is wounded in action, leaving Bat to save Ben's brother from the hangman's noose. (Western) - 1958-11-19

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Dude's Folly
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat comes to the aid of two youths who are being bullied into selling the hardware and feed store they inherited from their late father. (Western) - 1958-11-26

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Hidden Gunman
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sheriff Hollister arrests pretty Anita Torreon as a receiver of loot for a holdup gang and takes her to Prescott to stand trial; aboard the stagecoach, a disguised gunman suddenly appears to rescue Anita and recover the loot. (Western) - 1959-10-23

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Lady and the Gun
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Beautiful Elizabeth Blythe comes from New York to Tombstone to write a story about the town too tough to die; her nose for news promptly leads her into mortal danger when she is captured by outlaw Ed Chandler. (Western) - 1959-10-30

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Cast a Long Shadow
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank. (Western) - 1959

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Gambler Wore a Gun
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The new owner (Jim Davis) of a ranch has a problem with the deed, caused by a noose. (Western) - 1961

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Oklahoma Territory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Amid conflicts between the Cherokee tribe and Oklahoma's white settlers, the tribe's chief, Buffalo Horn (Ted de Corsia), is framed for murder. District Attorney Temple Houston (Bill Williams) must put aside his friendship with the chief and budding romance with the chief's daughter, Ruth Red Hawk (Gloria Talbott), to prosecute the case. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult. (Western) - 1960

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bandera Bandits
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A lawman (Telly Savalas) is determined to catch a pair of ruthless criminals (Tomas Milian, Susan George) as they rob their way across Mexico. (Western, Comedy) - 1972

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Broken Star
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim. (Western) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: High, Wild and Free
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Filmmaker Gordon Eastman's chronicle of a summer spent exploring the natural wonders of British Columbia. (Documentary) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Treasure of Worry Hill
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Three cousins who've inherited pieces of a treasure map from their late uncle hire Bat to lead them to the place they believe the money has been hidden. (Western) - 1958-12-03

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Cheyenne Club
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat tries to uncover a possible card sharp, but his investigation could prove lethal when the subject makes plans to kill Bat. (Western) - 1958-12-17

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Man from Yuma
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Released from prison together, Jake Conroy and Hobe Jones scheme to rob a rich mine owner; with the cash in their control, the thieves ride hard from Mexico with Sheriff Clay Hollister and Editor Harris Claibourne in pursuit. (Western) - 1959-11-06

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Indian Giver
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister stops gunman Jess Buckhorn from shooting Little Hawk, who denies stealing horses from a mission; attorney Fred Griffin, the gunman's secret employer, is plotting to discredit the Indians so he can gain title to their land. (Western) - 1959-11-13

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Rebel in Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge. (Western) - 1956

Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. (Crime drama) - 1972

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Reindeer Games
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor. (Drama) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The King's Speech
showtimeshowcase.us.description: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2010

showtimewomen.us.title: Love, Rosie
showtimewomen.us.description: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles. (Romantic comedy) - 2014

showtimewomen.us.title: Smart People
showtimewomen.us.description: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

showtimewomen.us.title: Grumpier Old Men
showtimewomen.us.description: Elderly, angling and contentious friends Max (Walter Matthau) and John (Jack Lemmon) back-burner their bickering when their kids (Kevin Pollak, Daryl Hannah) get engaged, but fishing season opens a can of romantic worms as newcomer Maria (Sophia Loren) plans to turn their beloved bait shop into a restaurant. Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love. (Comedy) - 1995

showtimewomen.us.title: Vanilla Sky
showtimewomen.us.description: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Safe Haven
showtimewomen.us.description: Katie Feldman moves to a small town on the North Carolina coast, determined to make a new life for herself. She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. With the help of Alex and his children, Katie learns to love and trust again, but when a mysterious stranger arrives and starts asking questions, Katie's dark past threatens to reclaim her. (Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery, Fantasy) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: An Unfinished Life
showtimewomen.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: The Aviator
showtimewomen.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: The Mexican
showtimewomen.us.description: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Days of Thunder
showtimewomen.us.description: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (Action, Drama, Romance) - 1990

showtimewomen.us.title: Gravity
showtimewomen.us.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: Red Eye
showtimewomen.us.description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official. - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
showtimewomen.us.description: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact. - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
showtimewomen.us.description: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination. - 2003

showtimewomen.us.title: The Ruins
showtimewomen.us.description: Tourists fall prey to carnivorous vines ensnaring the ruins of an ancient Mayan temple. - 2008

showtimewomen.us.title: The Mexican
showtimewomen.us.description: A bungling gangster (Brad Pitt) must reform to please his girlfriend (Julia Roberts) but still has one last job to fulfill. - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Regarding Henry
showtimewomen.us.description: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter. - 1991

showtimewomen.us.title: The Firm
showtimewomen.us.description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse. - 1993

showtimewomen.us.title: Match Point
showtimewomen.us.description: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson). - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: Haunter
showtimewomen.us.description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: The Butcher's Wife
showtimewomen.us.description: A folksy seaside clairvoyant (Demi Moore) marries a New York butcher (George Dzundza), moves to the city and charms her new neighbors. - 1991

showtimewomen.us.title: A Very Brady Sequel
showtimewomen.us.description: A man claiming to be Carol Brady's long-lost first husband, Roy Martin, shows up at the suburban Brady residence one evening. - 1996

showtimewomen.us.title: We're the Millers
showtimewomen.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action, Crime drama) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
showtimewomen.us.description: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician. (Comedy) - 2021

showtimewomen.us.title: Furlough
showtimewomen.us.description: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. (Comedy) - 2018

showtimewomen.us.title: The Stepford Wives
showtimewomen.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: Winchester
showtimewomen.us.description: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy) - 2018

showtimewomen.us.title: The Uninvited
showtimewomen.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

shoxbetwest.us.title: Seaside
shoxbetwest.us.description: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Regarding Us
shoxbetwest.us.description: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. (Drama, Comedy) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: All Up in the Biz
shoxbetwest.us.description: Celebrity interviews and rare archival footage provide insight into the life and legacy of hip-hop icon Biz Markie. (Documentary, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kevin Garnett: Anything Is Possible
shoxbetwest.us.description: Chronicling the career of one of the NBA's all-time greats, featuring scenes from Garnett's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2021-11-12

shoxbetwest.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology) - 2022-06-12

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kickback
shoxbetwest.us.description: A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world. (Documentary) - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pretty Red Dress
shoxbetwest.us.description: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. (Drama) - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
shoxbetwest.us.description: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: The One and Only Dick Gregory
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Andre Gaines examines the remarkable life and career of stand-up comic, activist and pop culture icon Dick Gregory. Features interviews with Dave Chappelle, Chris Rock, Kevin Hart and others. (Documentary) - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Persona
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. (Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: S.O.G.: The Book of Ward
shoxbetwest.us.description: Andre Ward, facing an all-too familiar series of obstacles, defies the odds and silences his critics with an undefeated boxing career, but walks away after choosing his role as a father and a husband over boxing. (Documentary) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hamburger Hill
shoxbetwest.us.description: An account of the 101st Airborne Division's 10-day struggle to secure a strategic mountainside in South Vietnam. - 1987

shoxbetwest.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
shoxbetwest.us.description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town. - 1982

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rules of Engagement
shoxbetwest.us.description: A decorated career Marine (Samuel L. Jackson), about to stand trial for a botched rescue mission, asks an old friend (Tommy Lee Jones) to defend him. - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Stand
shoxbetwest.us.description: Basketball star and social justice activist Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf endures a childhood of bullying due to Tourette's syndrome and is the target of hate speech and Islamophobia during his basketball career.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sound of Violence
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pretty Red Dress
shoxbetwest.us.description: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: Coach Carter
shoxbetwest.us.description: A high-school basketball coach (Samuel L. Jackson) turns a losing team around, then faces criticism for pushing the athletes to put grades first. - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
shoxbetwest.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: Attica
shoxbetwest.us.description: During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Fist Fight
shoxbetwest.us.description: Fired from his teaching job for losing his cool, a disgruntled man (Ice Cube) challenges the colleague (Charlie Day) who snitched on him to a fight after school. - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Nobody's Fool
shoxbetwest.us.description: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: B******': The Sound and Fury of Rick James
shoxbetwest.us.description: A raw and intimate documentary look at the wildly colorful life of legendary funk artist Rick James; original interviews with artists, collaborators and friends. (Special, Documentary) - 2021-09-03

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hard Truths
shoxbetwest.us.description: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. (Comedy drama) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Fist Fight
shoxbetwest.us.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Nobody's Fool

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!
shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising. (Documentary) - 2017

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Happy Feet
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Son of Memphis and Norma, little sweet penguin Mumble has a big problem: he can't sing a single note. In a world where everyone needs a heart song to attract a soul mate, Mumble feels he doesn't belong there. Our hero Mumble is the worst singer in the world, but he can tap dance brilliantly.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Happy Feet Two
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Antz
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Boss Baby
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

starz.us.description: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiancé. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage. (Romance, Drama) - 2012

starz.us.title: Trainwreck
starz.us.description: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act. (Romantic comedy) - 2015

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - For Bros About to Rock; It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert, and Luna is determined to make it the greatest experience ever; when Lincoln finds a letter in the attic, he begins to believe there is money hidden somewhere in the house.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Silence of the Luans; Undercover Mom
teennick.us.description: Luan is locked in a cell in the basement; Mom goes undercover as a student at the high school and becomes best friends with Leni, Luna and Luan.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Mad Scientist; Missed Connection
teennick.us.description: Lisa gets invited to work at an institute and get away from her crazy family; Lori and Bobby worry that long-distance dating is causing them to lose their connection.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cow Pie Kid; Saved by the Spell
teennick.us.description: Lynn pushes Liam to his limits when he becomes the star pitcher for the middle school baseball team; Lincoln's friends try to stop him from performing a magic act at the middle school talent show.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Deep Cuts; Game Off
teennick.us.description: When Luna discovers that the high school music club will be axed due to budget cuts, she leads a protest; desperate to play Lincoln's trash-themed video game, Lana conspires to distract her brother away from the console.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Back Out There; Spell It Out
teennick.us.description: Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues; tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book to teach her siblings a lesson.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Legends; Mall of Duty
teennick.us.description: Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and cannot wait to for a whole day of father-and-son bonding; Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Dine and Bash; Sofa, So Good
teennick.us.description: After failing to make chef Guy Grazer a meal on his show, the kids try to erase the footage before it airs; the kids search all over Royal Woods to find the missing furniture they left outside while cleaning.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loud Cloud; You Auto Know Better
teennick.us.description: Tired of Mom's sticky note system, Lincoln and Lisa create an app to keep track of the family's schedule; Lana creates an auto body shop to try and buy a new bike, but her shop turns corrupt when Flip becomes her mentor.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - No Laughing Matter; No Spoilers
teennick.us.description: When Luan overhears her siblings complaining about her comedy, she decides to give it up; knowing Leni's history of spoiling surprises, the children decide not to tell her about their mother's upcoming party.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Europe Road Trip: A Bite in Transylvania; Greece Is the Word
teennick.us.description: When the Loud's bus gets a flat tire, they're invited to stay the night in a spooky couple's mysterious castle; during a tour of the Parthenon, Lincoln puts on a soldier's helmet which sends him back to Ancient Greece.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - School of Shock; Electshunned
teennick.us.description: Lisa takes over her first-grade classroom and learns that there's more to teaching than just knowing facts; Leni goes toe-to-toe with the mayor in a citywide Royal Woods election.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Change of Heart; Health Kicked
teennick.us.description: Clyde is desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, so he enlists Leni's help; worried that their parents are hurting their health from not being active, the children encourage them to exercise.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Don't Escar-go; Double Trouble
teennick.us.description: When Clyde receives an opportunity to study cooking in France, the gang tries to keep him closer to home; Lola and Lana take on Cheryl and Meryl for the position of twin spokespeople for Auntie Pam's Parlor.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Kings of the Con
teennick.us.description: Eager to be named Kings of the Con at the Ace Savvy convention, Lincoln and Clyde convince the sisters to go with them as the Full Deck; when the girls get more attention, the boys do whatever it takes to gain focus.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Pop Pop the Question; Lynn and Order
teennick.us.description: When the kids discover Myrtle has a shady past, they try to expose her before Pop Pop proposes; Lynn and Liam butt heads when they're forced to partner up as the middle school hall monitors.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Suite and Sour; Back in Black
teennick.us.description: When the Loud parents win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the children with them because the children have promised to behave; when Lucy gets a crush on a "regular and normal" boy, her sisters decide to give her a makeover.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Music to my Fears; Fluff and Foiled
teennick.us.description: Luna and the Moon Goats have to find a replacement guitarist for the band when Luna injures her hands from playing; to make it to Udder Madness Day at Dairyland, Lincoln is determined to get laundry duty finished quickly.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Meet Cute Crush
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray try to help Piper get to know a new boy she likes from school.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Cave the Date
teennick.us.description: Henry and the gang set up a secret underground restaurant in the Man Cave for Charlotte's private dinner with music superstar Jack Swagger; when word gets out that Jack Swagger is in town, some unwanted guests crash the party.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Drex
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's old sidekick and nemesis, Drex, returns from the past with an army of cavemen to finish off Captain Man once and for all; Kid Danger may be the only one who can save Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Diamonds Are for Heather
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to prevent the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Up the Stairs!
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray's friendship is put to the ultimate test when they have to endure the half-mile trek up the Man Cave stairs in order to make a surprise meal by a celebrity chef in Junk-N-Stuff.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Tears of the Jolly Beetle
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man loses his powers of invulnerability and becomes too afraid to fight crime, Kid Danger must keep Swellview safe.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Elevator Kiss
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger rescues Bianca, and they share a kiss; Henry is upset when he realizes that Bianca kissed Kid Danger.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toon in for Danger
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible; they must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - EnvyGram Wall
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger guard Swellview's newest attraction, the EnvyGram Wall; when Captain Man destroys the wall while trying to eliminate a small bird, Kid Danger and Captain Man have to figure out a way to replace it.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - I Know Your Secret
teennick.us.description: When Henry receives a series of mysterious notes from someone, he begins to worry that the sender may know his secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Green Fingers
teennick.us.description: After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally affects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Tale of Two Pipers
teennick.us.description: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future; when a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, the gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Love Muffin
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Fiñata Full of Death Bugs
teennick.us.description: When a dangerous piñata winds up at a child's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover to step in before it is too late.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Revenge of the Smith
teennick.us.description: Excited to be honored for their heroism with a school mural, Phoebe and Max learn that the artist holds a personal grudge, and the tribute isn't what they imagined.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Thunder Van
teennick.us.description: The children sneak into the Thundervan for an unauthorized joyride.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Doubles Trouble
teennick.us.description: Phoebe enlists Max's help in a tennis tournament in order to win a membership at Link's family's country club.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Adventures in Supersitting
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max Thunderman are twins in a family of superheroes; Phoebe strives to use her powers for good, and Max embraces the dark side.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Floral Support
teennick.us.description: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet, but breaks her trust to pull off his plan. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-10-21

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Kiss Me Nate
teennick.us.description: Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead in the school play opposite a cute boy, so he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-04-02

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Dinner Party
teennick.us.description: Max plans to sabotage dinner when Phoebe invites her crush's family over; an unexpected guest forces Phoebe and Max to work together. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2013-11-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Cherry Bad Things
teennick.us.description: Cherry visits and Max discovers Phoebe never took her sparkle power away; Phoebe promises to do so and has a girls' night with Cherry while Max hosts Jinx; Colosso gets jealous; Cherry's powers malfunction, nearly blowing Phoebe's cover. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-02-26

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - The Summer I Turned Giddy
teennick.us.description: Max is upset that Phoebe secretly partnered with Captain Perfect; he decides to have a new superhero partner, his best friend Gideon; things go wrong when Max tries to make Gideon a better superhero. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-07-22

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Loudest Yard; Raw Deal
teennick.us.description: When Lincoln's mother signs him up for peewee football, Lincoln schemes to have Lynn take his spot; Lincoln becomes a hypochondriac when Lucy reads his fortune and predicts that his day will end in disaster. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-10-19

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Day of the Dad; Small Blunder
teennick.us.description: Lori struggles to make a good impression on Bobby's dad after accidentally pushing him into a puddle; desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisa's shrink ray to school. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2023-03-26

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Write and Wrong; Purrfect Gig
teennick.us.description: Mom tries to convince a newspaper editor that her kids are perfect in order to land a parenting advice column job; Luna is hired to watch the McBrides' cat when they go out of town, but the job becomes more demanding than she imagined. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2020-04-29

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fed Up; Shell Shock
teennick.us.description: Tired of monotonous meals, the children make a plan to sabotage dinner so they can have pizza; Lincoln and Ronnie Anne have to take care of an egg baby, but Lincoln does not trust her with the fragile egg. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-04-13

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Heavy Meddle; Making the Case
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is tired of his sisters' meddling until he is being picked on at school; Lincoln records his sisters' most embarrassing moments. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-03

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - On Thin Ice; Room and Hoard
teennick.us.description: Lynn's extreme sports superstitions cause chaos; the kids try to convince Mom and Dad that they still play with their childhood toys. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2020-06-09

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Roughin' It; The Waiting Game
teennick.us.description: Lincoln worries that he has lost his manliness from growing up with sisters, so he and Clyde decide to go camping; Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but Lori gets in trouble when he starts to ask for favors. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-09-15

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Roadie to Nowhere; A Fridge Too Far
teennick.us.description: Luna learns Chunk was like her in high school and worries her ambition to be a rocker is unrealistic; Lincoln wages war after his food is filched from the refrigerator. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-01-19

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Power Play With the Casagrandes; Room for Improvement With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When a high utility bill threatens Hector and Rosa's annual trip, Ronnie Anne spearheads an effort to lower usage; desperate for their own space, Ronnie Anne and Sid find a hidden room and try to keep it from the other tenants. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-06-11

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Leave No Van Behind; Sponsor Tripped
teennick.us.description: When Vanzilla seems too broken down to ever drive again, Lana, Dad and Gramps band together to fix her; Lynn and friends enjoy free perks around Royal Woods when their team gets sponsored by local businesses. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2023-09-12

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Future Tense; Lynner Takes All
teennick.us.description: After meeting an impressive family, the Loud parents worry that their children are not doing enough to ensure successful futures; tired of Lynn's poor sportsmanship during board games, the siblings decide to team up to take her down. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-09-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Out of the Picture; Room With a Feud
teennick.us.description: Afraid they will be forgotten, Lincoln and Clyde want to make a splash in the yearbook and crash group photos; seeing his sisters fight with their roommates, Lincoln suggests a room shuffle based on a compatibility test. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-05-17

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Scoop Snoop; Eye Can't
teennick.us.description: The Action News team struggles to find out how Katherine Mulligan is scooping their news leads; trying to avoid a trip to the eye doctor, Lisa makes a new pair of glasses that actually makes her eyesight worse. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-04-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Intern for the Worse; The Old and the Restless
teennick.us.description: When Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's, they compete to win the title of manager; after seeing how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his advanced age, Lincoln takes him out for a day to remember. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2016-11-10

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Director's Rut; Friday Night Fights
teennick.us.description: Luan turns to Mr. Coconuts for help after she struggles to direct her school's play; Lisa joins Lynn's football team as the analytics coach to prove that math will always beat out heart. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-21

themoviechannel.us.title: Three Wishes
themoviechannel.us.description: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. (Fantasy) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays. (Holiday, Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Smart People
themoviechannel.us.description: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Faculty
themoviechannel.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream
themoviechannel.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 4
themoviechannel.us.description: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour. - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Norbit
themoviechannel.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives. (Biography, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Doin' It
themoviechannel.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. (Comedy) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: 68 Kill
themoviechannel.us.description: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Ruins
themoviechannel.us.description: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery) - 2008

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strike Up the Band
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance. (Musical comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pot o' Gold
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater. (Musical comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: God Is My Co-Pilot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Col. Robert L. Scott is an adept fighter pilot who unfortunately finds himself too old to fly fighter planes in World War II. Assigned to India, he later meets Maj. Gen. Claire L. Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers. (Biography) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: My Wild Irish Rose
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this musical, Chauncey Olcott (Dennis Morgan) -- a character based on the real-life 19th-century singer-songwriter -- starts off as a minstrel show performer, but his life and career completely change when singer Lillian Russell (Andrea King) gives him a starring role in a Broadway show. Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While waiting for his Balkan country to vote on whether to abolish its monarchy, Prince Henry (Dennis Morgan) comes to New York City to observe ordinary life. Slipping away in disguise from his welcome party, the prince becomes friends with cab driver Buzz Williams (Jack Carson). After Buzz discovers the prince's identity, he lets his girlfriend, Connie (Joan Leslie), show the royal around the city. As the public wonders where the prince has disappeared to, he and Connie fall in love. (Comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Desert Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad. (Musical) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Vengeance Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ten Tall Men
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sgt. Mike Kincaid is a rough-and-tumble French Foreign Legion leader who, while imprisoned in a stockade, overhears rumors of an enemy attack on his company's fort. Later, in between fighting amongst themselves over a beautiful French lady, Mike and his ragtag group of fighters improvise a plan to kidnap Mahla (Jody Lawrence), the daughter of a local sheik. Though she hates Mike and his band of thieves at first, she soon realizes they are the least of her worries. (Action) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet Smell of Success
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: New York City newspaper writer J.J. Hunsecker (Burt Lancaster) holds considerable sway over public opinion with his Broadway column, but one thing that he can't control is his younger sister, Susan (Susan Harrison), who is in a relationship with aspiring jazz guitarist Steve Dallas (Marty Milner). Hunsecker strongly disapproves of the romance and recruits publicist Sidney Falco (Tony Curtis) to find a way to split the couple, no matter how ruthless the method. (Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: From Here to Eternity
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At an Army barracks in Hawaii in the days preceding the attack on Pearl Harbor, lone-wolf soldier and boxing champion Prew Prewitt (Montgomery Clift) refuses to box, preferring to play the bugle instead. Hard-hearted Capt. Holmes (Philip Ober) subjects Prew to a grueling series of punishments while, unknown to Holmes, the gruff but fair Sgt. Warden (Burt Lancaster) engages in a clandestine affair with the captain's mistreated wife (Deborah Kerr). (Drama, Romance, War) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang. - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Come Back, Little Sheba
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A housewife (Shirley Booth) and her alcoholic husband (Burt Lancaster) rent a spare room to a pretty student (Terry Moore). - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Trapeze
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two aerialists (Burt Lancaster, Tony Curtis) and a tumbler (Gina Lollobrigida) form a triple-somersault circus triangle. - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Jim Thorpe, All American
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Coach Pop Warner (Charles Bickford) recalls the Oklahoma Indian (Burt Lancaster) forced to return his medals from the 1912 Olympics. - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It's Always Fair Weather
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A talk-show staffer (Cyd Charisse) puts a fight manager (Gene Kelly), adman (Dan Dailey) and cook on TV 10 years after they parted as GIs. - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost Squadron
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Prussian director (Erich von Stroheim) demands realism from a Hollywood stunt pilot (Richard Dix) and his buddies. - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An innocent man is sent to a prison farm, where he endures the dehumanizing effects of a cruel criminal justice system. - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Key Largo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A gangster (Edward G. Robinson) holds a GI (Humphrey Bogart) and others hostage in a run-down Florida Keys hotel. - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Subject Was Roses
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A World War II veteran (Martin Sheen) comes home to his bickering parents (Patricia Neal, Jack Albertson). - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Some Came Running
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An ex-GI writer (Frank Sinatra) hangs out with a gambler (Dean Martin) and a floozy (Shirley MacLaine) in his hometown. - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Till the End of Time
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Despite being welcomed home as a hero, youthful Marine Cliff Harper (Guy Madison) tries to forget the horrific violence of World War II as he faces uncertainty, unemployment and post-traumatic stress. While transitioning back to civilian life, Cliff falls for Pat Ruscomb (Dorothy McGuire), a grieving widow haunted by the loss of her pilot husband. Cliff struggles to convince Pat to join him in a mutual new beginning, but first she must overcome her longing for her life before the war. (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: In Harm's Way
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Naval Captain Torrey (John Wayne) manages to bring his ship through the bombing of Pearl Harbor unscathed, but is later demoted when it is damaged in a subsequent battle due to his negligence. Back on land, he begins a reconciliation with his estranged son (Brandon de Wilde) and a romance with nurse Maggie (Patricia Neal), but duty calls him away when he and his firebrand friend, Cmdr. Paul Eddington (Kirk Douglas), are tasked with salvaging a dangerous and important mission. (War, Drama) - 1965

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Adaptation of the Pierre Boulle novel about POWs in Burma forced to build a bridge to aid the war effort of their Japanese captors. British and American officers plot to blow up the structure, but the commander of the bridge's construction has different plans. (War, Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Deer Hunter
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1968, Michael (Robert De Niro), Nick (Christopher Walken) and Steven (John Savage), lifelong friends from a working-class Pennsylvania steel town, prepare to ship out overseas following Steven's elaborate wedding and one final group hunting trip. In Vietnam, their dreams of military honor are quickly shattered by the inhumanities of war; even those who survive are haunted by the experience, as is Nick's hometown sweetheart, Linda (Meryl Streep). (War, Drama) - 1978
