classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-11-28

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 4 in B-Dur, op. 60
classica.us.description: "Les Dissonances" spielen die 4. Sinfonie von Ludwig van Beethoven an der Opéra Dijon. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2013-01-01

classica.us.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. Carnaval, Op. 9 wurde in den Jahren 1834-1835 geschrieben. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-11-07

classica.us.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf
classica.us.description: Das weltberühmte sinfonische Märchen von Sergej Prokofjew wird in einer neuen Interpretation präsentiert. Der Dirigent erzählt die Geschichte auf seine Art und wird dabei vom Britten-Pears Orchester musikalisch unterstützt. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2019-11-16

classica.us.title: Barocke Chormusik von Bach, Schütz u.a
classica.us.description: Die amarcordplus-Formation präsentiert ein Programm, zugeschnitten auf die Stadt der Aufführung. Dieses Mal werden geistliche Madrigale von Johann Hermann Schein, Motetten aus Heinrich Schütz sowie zwei Motetten von Johann Sebastian Bach aufgeführt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-04-28

classica.us.title: Sinfonien in D von Mozart und Voríšek
classica.us.description: Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert das Gewandhausorchester im Gewandhaus in Leipzig im Jahr 2020. Das Programm beginnt mit der Sinfonie in D-Dur, op. 23, des böhmischen Komponisten Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek. Das Werk ist die einzige Sinfonie des Komponisten. (Family, Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-06-02

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonien und Klavierkonzert Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer leitet sein Budapest Festival Orchester in einem Konzertprogramm, das der Musik von Ludwig van Beethoven gewidmet ist. Das Programm beginnt mit der Symphonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, Op. 21 und Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur, Op. 58. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-10

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Derek Wang
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Derek Wang tritt mit dem CMIM-Ensemble auf, das aus drei führenden Streichern des Orchestre symphonique de Montréal besteht. Gemeinsam interpretieren sie den ersten Satz, Allegro, aus Johannes Brahms' Klavierquartett Nr. 1 in g-Moll. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2025-03-04

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino sowie vier Gesangssolisten in einer prächtigen Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626. Die Solisten sind die Sopranistin Christiane Karg, die Mezzosopranistin Sara Mingardo, der Tenor Matthew Swensen und der Bass Gianluca Buratto. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2024-11-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur. (Special) - 2026-05-23

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Sinfonie Nr. 7, Op. 70
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer und das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino spielen Werke von Mozart und Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. Im Anschluss wird Antonín Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7 in d-Moll dargeboten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-06-09

classica.us.title: Mozarts 38. Sinfonie, KV 504
classica.us.description: Gerd Albrecht dirigiert die Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie bei einer Aufführung von Mozarts 38. Prager Sinfonie. Mozart komponierte sie Ende 1786, die Premiere fand im Januar 1787 während des ersten Pragbesuchs des Komponisten statt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-06-05

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Liszts 1. Klavierkonzert & Mahlers 5. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Michael Tilson Thomas dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Franz Liszts Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 in Es-Dur und Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 5. Der tschechische Pianist Lukáš Vondráček ist der Solist in Liszts Konzert. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-13

classica.us.title: Divas and Diamonds
classica.us.description: Der Film unternimmt eine Zeitreise in die Ära der Schwarz-Weiß-Filme, als Stars wie Marilyn Monroe, Judy Garland und Audrey Hepburn die Zuschauer in Filmen mit ihren unvergesslichen Stimmen und ihrer Ausdruckskraft verzauberten. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. outlaw.us.title: One-Eyed Jacks
outlaw.us.description: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts. (Western, Drama) - 1961

outlaw.us.title: Miracle in the Wilderness
outlaw.us.description: A 1850s couple (Kris Kristofferson, Kim Cattrall) and their baby are kidnapped at Christmas by a Blackfeet chief (Sheldon Peters Wolfchild) avenging his son. (Holiday, Western) - 1991

outlaw.us.title: Fort Vengeance
outlaw.us.description: Two North Dakota brothers (James Craig, Keith Larsen) flee to Canada and join the Mounties during an Indian dispute. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: She Wore a Yellow Ribbon
outlaw.us.description: The last job of Calvary Captain Nathan Brittles (John Wayne) before retirement is to soothe relations with the Cheyenne and Arapaho Indians after Custer's last stand. At the same time, he must transport the wife (Mildred Natwick) and niece (Joanne Dru) of his commanding officer to a safe destination. After both his missions stall, Brittles attempts a face-to-face meeting with an important Native American chief in order to stave off an impending war. (Western, Adventure) - 1949

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers
outlaw.us.description: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: Cheyenne Autumn
outlaw.us.description: Large-scale frontier epic telling the true story of a band of Cheyenne Indians who, starved nearly to extinction on an inhospitable reservation, embark on the long trek back to their distant ancestral homelands in Wyoming, despite opposition from the US Army. Their journey revives old hatreds - and the threat of war. (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: Chisum
outlaw.us.description: Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: Badman's Territory
outlaw.us.description: A Texas sheriff (Randolph Scott) seeks his brother and finds the Oklahoma hide-out of the Dalton and James gangs. - 1946

outtvproud.us.title: The Skulls
outtvproud.us.description: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price. (Thriller) - 2000

outtvproud.us.title: Drama Drama
outtvproud.us.description: Teenage girls use their newly formed pop group to take a stand against bullying in their high school. (Drama, Music, Pop) - 2019

outtvproud.us.title: Brave New Girl
outtvproud.us.description: Holly (Lindsey Haun), an aspiring singer from Texas, embarks on a journey of self-discovery when she's accepted into a prestigious East Coast performing arts school. Leaving family and boyfriend behind to pursue her dreams, fish-out-of-water Holly comes up against fierce competition and elitist attitudes from her classmates. But with the support of her mother, Wanda (Virginia Madsen), and roommate Ditz (Jackie Rosenbaum), Holly overcomes all obstacles in her path to become the next big pop star. (Drama) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Generation Um...
outtvproud.us.description: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera. (Drama) - 2012

outtvproud.us.title: Blue Steel
outtvproud.us.description: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Freeway
outtvproud.us.description: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: Duchess

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Paid Off, Styled Up Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Speakeasy to Me Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Suite Retreat Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 A Pop of Color Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 New Generation Style Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Two Sisters, One Home Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Elevated Oasis With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Every Woman's Dream Home Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Old Plan to Open Floor Plan Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Food Meets Art
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Welcome to Guadalajara
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hacienda Ranch Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Blessing and The Benefit
tastemadetravel.us.description: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour. (Cooking) - 2024-01-25

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hermosillo Food Crawl
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer. (Cooking) - 2024-01-25

thestandupchannel.us.title: Nemr: No Bombing in Beirut
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed in Lebanon and America, the comic discusses his childhood in America and his later years in Lebanon.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Louis Anderson: Big Baby Boomer
thestandupchannel.us.description: Veteran funny man Louie Anderson returns to the stage in this hilarious one hour stand-up comedy special; Louie takes an unconventional and jovial look at his bad habits, pesky family members, and aging body.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
thestandupchannel.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Robert Schimmel: Life Since Then
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comedian and author Robert Schimmel has plenty to say on everything from raising a 17-year-old daughter to bargaining with God, and not making friends with a dolphin.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Marc Yaffee: Mid-Laugh Crisis
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comedian Marc Yaffee performs in a stand-up special.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated

thestandupchannel.us.title: Dennis Miller: America 180
thestandupchannel.us.description: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tom Papa: Human Mule

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: Home for the Holidays

thestandupchannel.us.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
thestandupchannel.us.description: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated

travel.us.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
travel.us.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen. (Paid Program, Health)

travel.us.title: Overwhelmed with IRS Debt? Keys to Resolving Tax Debt
travel.us.description: See how one company is changing people's lives by helping them put their tax problems to rest. (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Tired of Aging? Super Pill's Secret to Lasting Youth & Vitality!
travel.us.description: Tired of feeling old? Discover The Super Pill! 6 elite formulas packed with clinically studied ingredients for revolutionary heart, brain, joint, immune, skin, and eye health. Don't just age-thrive! Unlock your ultimate vitality and well-being today. (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera - Theatre of Screams & The Haunted Bridge
travel.us.description: Two explorers are shaken to the core after a series of blood-curdling encounters on a haunted bridge; Bailey is terrorized by ghostly intruders at an historic theater and a paranormal duo investigate a derelict mansion - all caught on camera. (Performing Arts, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera - Scary Mary & The Alien Abduction
travel.us.description: A haunted museum claims to house the most possessed doll in the U.K.; in Yorkshire, Russell claims to have been abducted by aliens over 60 times. (Performing Arts, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Destinations of the Damned with Zak Bagans - Cursed Shores
travel.us.description: Horrors await Zak Bagans' team when they explore two islands; in Singapore, a lush jungle paradise harbors a vengeful spirit; in Canada, miners may have unleashed evil on a small town. (Documentary)

travel.us.title: Destinations of the Damned with Zak Bagans - Nazi Portal to Hell
travel.us.description: The crew steps behind a Czech castle's walls to hunt for a portal to hell; venturing into an abandoned hotel in the Philippines with a cursed past. (Documentary)

travel.us.title: Destinations of the Damned with Zak Bagans - The Asylum's Prophet
travel.us.description: After witnessing spirit conjuring inside a Canadian roadhouse, Zak Bagans' team explores an asylum in Italy where a patient's cryptic carvings predicted the moon landing. (Documentary)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Night Radio, Lady in Red and Spirit Alley
travel.us.description: A radio host's dream job is threatened by the presence of two terrifying entities; a restaurant owner is confronted by the spirit of a lovelorn woman on Valentine's Day; ghostly footsteps and disembodied voices haunt an empty bowling alley at night. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Family Secrets, Third Shift and Night of the Undead
travel.us.description: Sam is an aspiring writer fascinated, some might say obsessed with the Salem witch trials; when a job is available as a night auditor in a Salem hotel steeped in history, Sam leaves Boston and takes the job. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Clown Boy's Revenge, She Follows Me and I.T
travel.us.description: A phantom clown stalks a custodian down the dark halls of an empty school; a poltergeist terrorizes guests at an upscale spa; an I.T. technician is confronted by a series of paranormal disturbances after he accepts an assignment at a haunted factory. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Sixth Sense, Dead Wood and Beware: I'm Watching
travel.us.description: A single mom protects herself from a paranormal attack; a factory worker hears growls and otherworldly sounds during a graveyard shift; a dorm supervisor is stalked by an unseen entity. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Scent of a Woman, The Resident and Curtain Call
travel.us.description: A museum director unleashes a trunkful of angry spirits; a care support worker must protect his sleeping charges from a dark paranormal presence; a high school custodian is taunted by a whistling entity while cleaning up a haunted auditorium. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Lady of the House, The Fire Chief, and Caretaker: Take Care
travel.us.description: The dead wife of an elderly patient watches his live-in caretaker's every move; a bartender at a trendy restaurant is spooked; a paranormal force attacks a custodian in an abandoned high school. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - The Empress, Trapped and Arcade Apparition
travel.us.description: The ghost of an actress terrorizes the night manager at a historic theater; vicious souls prey upon a security guard and his partner inside an old factory; a devious spirit in an arcade plays games with a teenage girl. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Soldier's Story, Dead Pool and Goodbye
travel.us.description: A dead soldier with a wicked temper attacks a military police officer in an abandoned building; the ghost of a drowned girl terrorizes the staff at a hotel; a restaurant manager comes face to face with a horrifying apparition. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Do Not Disturb and Hotel Hauntings
travel.us.description: Holiday joy turns into terror for an inn owner and her assistant during a snowstorm; a young man is a skeptic until he works the night shift at a hotel rumored to be haunted by dark and powerful spirits. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - It Crawls, Demons Walk With Us and Tortured Spirits
travel.us.description: Ronnie works the overnight shift at a group home which requires him to sleep over. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Night at the Museum; Friday Night Frights
travel.us.description: Troy's experience as a military police office has trained him in situational awareness and response to physical threats; he is forced to change his playbook when confronted by something of a paranormal nature. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Cries In the Dark; Late Night On Haunted Land; Ghost Bait
travel.us.description: A security guard hears ghostly wails at a secluded campground; a gas station clerk is plagued by unexplained terror while working the night shift; a mysterious intruder leaves an overnight manager on edge at a fishing resort. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Paranormal Nightshift - Late Shift at the Hall; The Night Watch
travel.us.description: A peace officer senses an unusual, unfriendly presence; a pianist is spooked at a concert hall. (Paranormal)

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Eddie Jaramillo

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dave Allen
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Motorcycle junkie and Army veteran Dave Allen recounts the terrifying prospect of facing chemical warfare during Operation Desert Storm with host Jay Garstecki and guest Paul Sr. from American Choppers.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : John Arroyo
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 Shot through the neck at Fort Hood in Texas, U.S. Special Forces Green Beret Captain John Arroyo recounts coming face-to-face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would-be killer.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Ginger Gilbert-Ravella
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Ginger Gilbert-Ravella honors the memory of her husband, Major Troy Gilbert, a USAF Pilot and American hero.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Tajikistan, a Mountainous Land
waypointtv.us.description: With the fall of the Soviet Union, wildlife populations in Tajikistan were devastated, bringing some of their unique mountain species to the brink of extinction.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Anti-Poaching in Tanzania The pressure of human encroachment and poaching is the greatest threat to wildlife in Africa; Dan Cabela travels to Tanzania to see how Robin Hurt Safaris manages two large conservation areas in the face of these daily challenges.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Human-Wildlife Conflict in Borneo Human-wildlife conflict is common in Borneo, where human populations are scattered throughout the landscape; Dan Cabela travels to the area to participate in an elephant collaring project showing how people and elephants can live harmoniously.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Barren Ground Musk Ox
waypointtv.us.description: A remnant of the last Ice Age, the musk ox is almost mythical in appearance. For the people who share the Barren Ground region of Canada with them, they are an integral part of their culture.

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : Live Fishing Report
waypointtv.us.description: S09 E03 PCB Fishing Report author Capt. Nathan Chennaux joins Capt. Justin scanning the beach waters for tarpon, and they hook into a monster while maneuvering around storms and vacationers. Does it make it into the boat?

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : Black Pearl's Final Resting Place
waypointtv.us.description: S09 E04 Joined by PCB's Artificial Reef Coordinator Erin Graham Capt Justin fish previously dropped reefs before sinking the famed BLACK PEARL from iconic films right off Panama City Beach, FL.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Opening Week in Mississippi Started Off With a Bang!!

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Precision Rifle Perfected

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Winchester Life - More Than A Medal

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Winchester Life - Missouri Deer Camp

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Walk, Ride, Rodeo…Hunt

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Show your Skull

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Florida Bay Variety

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Florida Bay Variety, Continued
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E08 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor continue to fish Florida Bay out of Hawks Cay, catching an incredible variety of flats species including tarpon, snook, redfish, trout and bonefish.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Marquesas Mixed Bag With Captain Bryson Shaaber
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E09 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to sample different fishing opportunities in the Marquesas Keys with Captain Bryson Shaaber.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Double Slam With Captain Nick LaBadie
waypointtv.us.description: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor meet up with Captain Nick LaBadie at Big Pine Key for an action-packed day. They're out on the flats chasing tarpon, bonefish, and permit for the elusive Grand Slam.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Goliaths Under the Bushes
waypointtv.us.description: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor run from Hawks Cay Resort to Islamorada on a windy day to fish under the mangroves for Goliath grouper.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Tarpon in the Key West Channels
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E03 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor join Captain Bryson Shaaber to fish the channels around Key West, targeting big spring tarpon with live pinfish bait.

waypointtv.us.title: Captain's Log
waypointtv.us.description: Highland Park Specks Capt. Jonathan Moss is at Highland Park Fish Camp, Speck fishing with Capt. James Hillman.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Knowledge : Local Knowledge - Key West
waypointtv.us.description: Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest; over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys.

waypointtv.us.title: Road Trip Angler : Exploring the Great Lakes
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E01 Jameson Redding hits the road to find the best fishing spots in America.

waypointtv.us.title: Destination Dive : Islamorada
waypointtv.us.description: WE WILL TAKE YOU ON AN INCREDIBLE JOURNEY VISITING THE MOST ICONIC WRECKS AND REEFS IN THIS AREA OF THE KEYS. AND WE WILL ALSO EXPLORE THE GROUNDBREAKING WORK THAT SCIENTISTS AND VOLUNTEERS ARE WORKING ON TO SHADE CORALS FROM THE HARSH SUNLIGHT.

waypointtv.us.title: Dirt
waypointtv.us.description: Louisiana's Wild Food & Award-Winning Cuisine; Hog Hunting, Swamp Fishing and more Dirt

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Big Horn Dilemma
waypointtv.us.description: Big horn sheep are one of North America's most spectacular animals, but future conservation requires large-scale, hands-on efforts. Joining a multi-agency translocation in Texas, Dan Cabela is in the thick of it.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Bison-Bison-Bison
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E01 Kyle Green and his buddy Jeremy set out on a buffalo hunt; along the way they learn about the true past and future of the American buffalo from interesting people with different perspectives.

waypointtv.us.title: Destination Dive : Volunteering to Help Our Oceans
waypointtv.us.description: An underwater odyssey, showcasing some of the best dive locations worldwide.

waypointtv.us.title: Stomping Grounds
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E05 Key West -- A Boater's Paradise Surrounded by water, Key West is a boater's paradise with seaports and marinas offering a bustling waterfront with historic schooners, dive boats, sport fishing charters, parasailing adventures and scenic coastal excursions.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: The Beginning Spending a full day on the water with his son, Larkin; teaching him, watching him learn and seeing the joy on his face; from chasing Bull Reds to sharing the places that shaped me growing up.

waypointtv.us.title: Goin' Coastal : Captain's Choice
waypointtv.us.description: Capt. Josh heads offshore with Marcus Castro for a day of fishing, hoping to reel in the perfect catch for tonight's family dinner.

waypointtv.us.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail : Patience
waypointtv.us.description: S16 E05 During a rough season for finding mature deer Beau heads out to try his luck on the only buck they have lined up.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office. It looked like a professional hit. With no leads, the investigation stalled. Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers. Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded. Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers. Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him. Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life. But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped. The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983. A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley. Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California. The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent. Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of becoming a doctor. But a tragic twist of fate intervened, when she found herself an innocent victim of the drug trade. Kidnapped and held captive, she survived for days against all odds. Authorities arrested her captors, but they refused to reveal her whereabouts. The FBI and local police raced against time, determined to save the teenager's life. Their investigation revealed a complex story of drugs, betrayal and revenge.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the mid-1990's, a gang of professional bank robbers raided cities across seven states. Disguises and speed protected their identity from cameras and the police as they stole hundreds of thousands of dollars, always leaving a bomb to terrorize their victims. The stakes were raised when the FBI discovered the robbers had an agenda beyond their personal wealth. To stop these extremists and their growing operation, the FBI needed to capture their leaders.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other. Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help. A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare. An 11-year-old girl was missing. Her parents were certain she was no runaway. When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police. The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl. Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and the truth.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight. Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions. The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the perseverance of a family, local authorities, and the FBI.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country. Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft. When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers. Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children. Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue. The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death. It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents. When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list. To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, a series of crimes in a small Iowa farming community left residents reeling in shock and fear. Two young men went on a crime spree of robbery, kidnapping and murder, and then disappeared. By the time they were identified, they already had a twelve-hour lead. As the hunt for the two men expanded, the FBI committed its resources to tracking down the suspects. The pursuit would take agents across six states to catch the killers before they struck again.

692051.description: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

692051.title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
692051.description: Residents of California's San Fernando Valley are under attack by flying saucers from outer space. 724210.description: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a pretty young stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's two older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight them both.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in North Fork in search of renegade Indians suspected of the brutal killing of a Texas Ranger and his family.

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog just can't resist a challenge, especially if it's to help out a friend. Jim is a bondsman and longtime friend of Dog. Jim's son has just started in the family business.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission--to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in--it's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Darkness has fallen, but with the trail hot and the stakes high Dog and posse refuse to let up. The "Big Fish" in this case is Marco, an alleged drug dealer with a big bond.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's relentless ruthlessness is being put to the test on the search for the elusive fugitive, Marco. Dog is tracking him across Colorado, from Grand Junction to Denver.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale. But this only masks deeper problems with the couple.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district--moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Baby Lyssa's wedding is only three days away, but Dog is thinking about bounties, not bouquets. A hot jump has comes in and Dog wants to go on the hunt.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

673500.description: Society girl Victoria Stafford (Ginger Rogers) garners a reputation for leaving men at the altar. Getting engaged for a fourth time, Victoria believes she's found the right man -- until on a train she has a strange dream about a Native American who claims that he is her true love. Awakening, Victoria is startled to find the dream man, George (Cornel Wilde), who claims to really exist, while also being a figment of her imagination. Back at home, George guides Victoria to a startling discovery.

673500.description: Clumsy sanitation worker Red Jones (Red Skelton) is fired from his street-cleaning job shortly after his girlfriend, Ann Elliot (Janet Blair), refuses his marriage proposal until he betters himself. While training to become a door-to-door salesman, he accidentally stumbles into a murder investigation when the corrupt sanitation commissioner (Nicholas Joy) who had fired him is killed. When the murder weapon is found to be one of the brushes Red sells, he must fight to prove his innocence.

673498.title: The Wild Westerners
673498.description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

673498.title: Gunman's Walk
673498.description: Rancher Lee Hackett (Van Heflin) spends so much time trying to keep the violent streak of his son Ed (Tab Hunter) in check, he neglects the needs of his other son Davy (James Darren). When Ed's temper results in the death of an innocent Native American, Lee tries his best to cover his son's tracks by making a deal with unscrupulous horse trader Jensen (Ray Teal), who falsely testifies on Ed's behalf. But it becomes clear that Ed can't change, and a shootout between father and son ensues.

673498.title: Indian Uprising
673498.description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

673498.title: Ten Wanted Men
673498.description: Rancher John Stewart (Randolph Scott) prefers to to resolve problems without falling back on violent solutions. However, fellow cattleman Wick Campbell (Richard Boone) isn't so peaceful, and he hires a team of armed mercenaries, led by ruthless Frank Scavo (Leo Gordon), to rid him of any possible competition. After narrowly surviving an attack from Scavo and his men, Stewart has little choice but to fight back in order to save both his ranch and his family, including nephew Howie (Skip Homeier).

673498.title: Good Day for a Hanging
673498.description: When the local sheriff is killed after a bank robbery, ex-lawman Ben Cutler (Fred MacMurray) collars the apparent killer, Eddie Campbell (Robert Vaughn). Because of his background as a local youth who spent time living with the Cutlers, Eddie gets the benefit of the doubt from Ben's daughter and his wife-to-be, Ruth (Margaret Hayes). Ben is firm in his belief that Eddie is guilty, and as the matter is debated in a divisive court battle, it will soon become clear whether or not he's right.

673498.title: Phantom Stagecoach
673498.description: A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.

673498.title: Last of the Comanches
673498.description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

673498.title: The Texas Rangers
673498.description: The Civil War has ended, the Union Army has pulled out, and now the Texas Rangers are needed once again to protect their state from harm. The newly reformed Rangers decide to take a chance by hiring a notorious outlaw Johnny Carver (George Montgomery). They offer the desperado amnesty for his previous crimes if he'll put his famous trigger finger to work for Texas. Carver agrees, but his new job won't be easy, as his old rival, the Sundance Kid (Ian MacDonald), is out for vengeance.

673498.title: Brave Warrior
673498.description: Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

673498.title: Major Dundee
673498.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: 45-year-old Natalie, who's visiting her sister from Australia, is found dead the morning after a heated argument with her estranged brother-in-law. Dr. G suspects foul play and she must race against the clock to give the police and Natalie's family the answers they need.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: After suffering an apparent seizure, 37-year-old Ruben Delgado is found lifeless by his girlfriend.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: 58-year-old Leroy Williams is rushed to the ER by his wife after becoming disorientated. Doctors work tirelessly, but Leroy slips into a coma and eventually dies.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: In a bizarre scene, 44-year-old Olga Petrova is found severely burnt in her home after a heated argument with her fiancé. Police want to question him and find out what happened, but he's nowhere to be found.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: After driving to his parent's house, Cameron Walker finds his dad dead in bed, and his mom bound in the closet.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An 82-year-old woman appears to have committed suicide by overdosing on painkillers, but Dr. G finds evidence that suggests that she may have died of a heart attack.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Dr. G preforms an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: In August of 1995, when Dr. G worked in Texas, a pile of human bones was found at a supposedly haunted railroad crossing. Dr. G was able to determine the age but not the sex.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An infant and his two-year-old sister are found dead in a house shared by two families. At first, they are believed to have died from either carbon monoxide poisoning or cold medicine overdoses.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Police patrolling the night streets hear gunshots and head to the scene. They find a nude middle-aged man in parking lot lying face down in a puddle of blood.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn't what it seems.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple haven't seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Melissa Riobe's life is ruled by her addiction to drugs. Now, the 42-year-old woman has learned how to buy powerful prescription drugs online without a doctor's note.
